oil.when: 2016 GL-Class with the ASSYST PLUS service display
steps: Have the oil, filter and scheduled service done first; the reminder is tied to the service actually being carried out.
The 2016 owner's manual gives no driver reset. It says the workshop that does the service resets the ASSYST PLUS service display afterward. If it was reset by mistake, a workshop has to correct it.

tpms.when: 2013–2016 GL-Class (US cars, tire pressure monitor showing each tire)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire and loading sticker on the driver's door pillar (or the table inside the fuel filler flap).
Switch the ignition on (key in position 2) and stay parked.
Use the left and right arrow buttons on the steering wheel to reach the Service menu.
Use the up and down arrows to choose Tire Pressure and press OK. The current pressures show.
Press the down arrow button. The display asks whether to use the current pressures as the new reference values.
Press OK to confirm. The display shows that the tire pressure monitor has restarted. Press the back button instead if you want to cancel.
Drive for a few minutes. The car checks the pressures and stores them as the new reference.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2013 and 2016 owner's manuals. If the tire warning lamp flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the monitor itself has a fault, and a restart will not clear it.

tpms.when: 2013–2016 GL-Class with the Run Flat Indicator (pressure loss warning, Canadian cars)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire and loading sticker on the driver's door pillar.
Switch the ignition on (key in position 2) and stay parked.
Use the left and right arrow buttons on the steering wheel to reach the Service menu, then the up and down arrows to choose Tire Pressure, and press OK.
The display reads Run Flat Indicator Active. Press OK.
When asked whether the tire pressure is now OK, choose Yes and press OK. The display confirms the run flat indicator has restarted.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2013 and 2016 owner's manuals. If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.

notes: The 2016 GL owner's manual says the workshop resets the ASSYST PLUS service reminder after the service, so no driver steps are given for it.
